controller_code:
import math

TAU_S = 0.3
SLEW_MW_S = 3.0
SOC_KP = 0.02
SOC_TARGET = 0.60
PRELOAD_MW = 25.0

def control(obs: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    p_raw = float(obs["p_raw_mw"])
    rated = float(obs["rated_mw"])
    dt = float(obs["dt"])
    soc = float(obs["soc"])
    b_max = float(obs["battery_max_power_mw"])
    cap = float(obs["battery_capacity_mwh"])
    e = float(obs["battery_energy_mwh"])
    idle = float(obs.get("idle_mw", obs["p_prev_grid_mw"]))
    st = obs["state"]

    if "y1" not in st:
        st["y1"] = idle
        st["pg"] = idle
        st["stride"] = max(1, int(round(0.1 / dt)))
        st["hist"] = [idle]
        st["cnt"] = 0

    dt_h = dt / 3600.0
    eta = math.sqrt(0.90)
    b_dis_max = min(b_max, max(0.0, (e - 0.1 * cap) * eta / dt_h))
    b_chg_max = min(b_max, max(0.0, (0.9 * cap - e) / (eta * dt_h)))

    preload = min(PRELOAD_MW, b_chg_max) if (p_raw <= idle + 2.0 and soc < 0.85) else 0.0
    desired_in = p_raw + preload + SOC_KP * (SOC_TARGET - soc) * b_max
    desired_in = min(rated, max(0.0, desired_in))

    alpha = dt / (TAU_S + dt)
    st["y1"] = (1.0 - alpha) * st["y1"] + alpha * desired_in

    max_d = SLEW_MW_S * dt
    p_target = st["pg"] + max(-max_d, min(max_d, st["y1"] - st["pg"]))

    step_dt = st["stride"] * dt
    n6 = max(1, int(round(6.0 / step_dt)))
    n60 = max(1, int(round(60.0 / step_dt)))
    h = st["hist"]
    w6 = h[-n6:]
    p_lo = max(0.0, max(w6) - 9.7, (h[-n60] if len(h) >= n60 else idle) - 19.5)
    p_hi = min(rated, min(w6) + 9.7, (h[-n60] if len(h) >= n60 else idle) + 19.5)
    p_target = min(p_hi, max(p_lo, p_target)) if p_lo <= p_hi else st["pg"]

    st["pg"] = p_target
    st["cnt"] += 1
    if st["cnt"] >= st["stride"]:
        st["cnt"] = 0
        h.append(p_target)
        if len(h) > n60 + 10:
            del h[:len(h) - n60 - 10]

    if p_target < p_raw - b_dis_max:
        return {"gpu_floor_mw": 0.0, "gpu_cap_mw": p_target + b_dis_max, "battery_setpoint_mw": b_dis_max}
    if p_target > p_raw + b_chg_max:
        return {"gpu_floor_mw": p_target - b_chg_max, "gpu_cap_mw": rated, "battery_setpoint_mw": -b_chg_max}
    return {"gpu_floor_mw": 0.0, "gpu_cap_mw": rated, "battery_setpoint_mw": p_raw - p_target}
